http_host.description: IP address or hostname on which the control agent HTTP server listens.

http_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP control interface.

user_file.description: Path to the user authentication file for HTTP Basic Auth.

control_sockets.description: List of KEA daemon control sockets to connect to.

type.description: Transport type: 'unix' for local sockets, 'http' for remote HTTP endpoints.

socket_type.description: Synonym of 'type'. For backward compatibility (KEA 2.0+ prefers 'socket-type').

socket_name.description: Path to Unix socket (e.g., '/var/lib/kea/dhcp4.ctl') or full HTTP URL (e.g., 'http://localhost:8001/') when type='http'.

allow_from.description: List of allowed client IP addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) that may connect to the control agent HTTP API.

log_level.description: Log level for control agent messages.

log_output.description: Log output destination: 'stdout', 'stderr', or path to log file.

log_debuglevel.description: Debug verbosity level (0–99); higher = more verbose. Set > 0 only when troubleshooting.
